label: nx_tuucyou_detailed_021
text: History of Box and point usage

label: nx_tuucyou_help1_010
text:
Welcome to the Notebook menu!
This is where you can check how you’ve been using Pokémon HOME.
Select an option, and then give me a nudge if you want more details on
what you can do!

label: nx_tuucyou_help2_010
text:
On the Records screen, you’ll be able to check all sorts of
different statistics that have been neatly counted up for you!
Golly, that’s helpful!

label: nx_tuucyou_help2_020
text:
If you look through the numbers, you might discover something
interesting about how you’ve been using Pokémon HOME!

label: nx_tuucyou_help3_010
text:
On the History screen, you can check the results of past
Box connections!

label: nx_tuucyou_help3_020
text:
If there’s an entry that you’d like to know more about, just scroll
to it and press the A Button! You’ll be taken to a separate page
with more information on the Pokémon you deposited or withdrew!

label: nx_tuucyou_help3_030
text:
Keep in mind, though, only 300 entries will be saved as records,
even if you deposit or withdraw a whole bunch of Pokémon
during one connection! Older entries will be automatically removed!

label: nx_tuucyou_help3_031
text:
Just so you know, you can check moving records from Pokémon Bank
and Pokémon you received on your mobile device here, too.
And guess what? You can also see how many Pokémon HOME Points
you’ve used!

label: nx_tuucyou_help4_010
text:
Oh boy! This is the detailed records screen!
You can check which Pokémon came to Pokémon HOME and
which ones left in each of your history entries!
Scroll through the pages by pressing the L Button or R Button!
